description: Questions for checking Ask (scripts/eval_ask.mjs), written from the hand-checked same-issue groups (10-17 Oct 2026). 'group' names the group whose stories answer the question; null means the evidence should not answer it and Ask should show nothing. First draft, written by Claude; to be checked by a person.
